messages.author: 6f17ff4d1bfe11d7
messages.subject: categorical variables with interactions
parts:
Hi,

I am working with categorical variables with interaction terms to identify the effect of the protected areas and non-protected areas. Can anyone tell where I am wrong?

Thanks in advance

code:
coords <- as.matrix(Final2[c(1:780),c(6,7)])
bnd = inla.nonconvex.hull(coords, convex = 0.05)
mesh <- inla.mesh.2d(boundary = bnd, loc = coords, max.edge=c(0.1, 0.1))
spde = inla.spde2.matern(mesh, constr = TRUE) 

Year = rep(1:nyears, 78)
coords$hhid = mesh$idx$loc
S = coords$hhid
year = year1 = Year
protected = as.factor(Final2$Protected[1:n])

n = 780
count = Final2$count[1:780]
count[count == 0] <- NA
y = count

fit <- inla(y ~ year * protected + f(S, model = spde) + f(year1, model = "ar1"),
        data = data.frame(y = y, year, year1, protected), 
        family = "zeroinflatednbinomial0", 
        control.family = list(link = "log"),
        control.compute = list(dic = TRUE,cpo = TRUE, po = TRUE, config = TRUE))
